claim: `RingHom.Finite.tensorProductMap` is an `AlgHom.Finite` theorem: its hypotheses are `Hf : f.Finite` and `Hg : g.Finite` for algebra homomorphisms, and its conclusion pretty-prints as `(Algebra.TensorProduct.map f g).Finite`. requested_change: Rename/move the public lemma to `AlgHom.Finite.tensorProductMap`, state the conclusion as `(Algebra.TensorProduct.map f g).Finite`, and keep a `change (Algebra.TensorProduct.map f g).toRingHom.Finite` at the start of the proof if needed. Update the private helper comment/reference accordingly.
